pages.text: $(thing)Fusarium Head Blight (Scab)$() ($(o)Fusarium graminearum$()), fungus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() common wheat, durum wheat, barley, oats, rye, maize.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() crop residue, airborne spores, rain splash.
$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 15-32 °C (best 27 °C), humidity above 90%, 24 h of wet leaves.

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 2 years (residue).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 50% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Do not sow wheat into maize residue; Plough under infected residue; Fungicide at anthesis; Moderately resistant cultivars.
Contaminates grain with the mycotoxin deoxynivalenol (DON, 'vomitoxin').
